record.reason: Independently re-reviewed HEAD ac2cf32 (worktree clean, no lifecycle/roadmap mutation: agent/next.md remains P20.3 READY_TO_RUN, agent/staged/P20.3.md and P20.4.md remain PENDING DESIGN). The seven round-2 blocking findings are genuinely closed at this HEAD: the dead `round_no < 2` recovery-cycle branch is gone and the semantic budget is now carried via `cumulative_remediation_rounds`/`first_round`; `adjudicate_plan_delta` now requires a real independent adjudicator dispatch with exact `resolved_findings` echo, nonblank `resolution_evidence`, request-id correlation, an additive-only bounded patch and `_parse_plan` revalidation (the substring oracle is removed); `cleanup_stale_role_tool_children` now requires exact request/resource correlation, captured `create_time`, graphify argv and a read-only subcommand, and appends rather than terminates on any ambiguity; the enqueue-failure path settles `rcv_decision.attempt_id` and the bare `except: pass` is gone; `AIBrokerExecutionPort.resource_snapshot()` supplies real identity/role/quality/health that `build_resource_availability` actually reads, making HETEROGENEOUS_ESCALATION reachable (verified by the watchdog second-attempt test asserting the anthropic target and the command-bound excluded list); `recovery_enabled` and `recovery_attempt_reservation_ttl_seconds` are now read; quarantined/corrupt families yield NO_ACTION_ALREADY_RECOVERED. Evidence reproduces on this HEAD: tests_py/test_p20_3_recovery_policy.py + recovery_durability + planner_bounds + cleanup_identity + adjudication_evidence + policy_controls + broker_resource_snapshot = 72 passed; test_ai_planner.py + test_control_commands.py + test_watchdog_recovery.py + test_watchdog.py + test_p145_reviewer_harness.py + test_p14_durable_jobs.py + test_planning_convergence_recovery.py = 176 passed, 22 subtests. The reviewed task is nevertheless not complete: three concrete, local, testable defects remain. (1) CONFIRMED by direct reproduction: when persisted `cumulative_remediation_rounds` exceeds the configured `max_plan_remediation_rounds`, `_run_cycle`'s `range(first_round, max_remediation_rounds + 1)` is empty, the plan is left in the non-terminal `planning` state with no `_finish`, no owner gate and no telemetry, and because `planning` is in `_ACTIVE_STATES` the project's planner lifecycle is permanently wedged ('planner lifecycle already active for project') with no automatic or owner-visible exit. (2) Gap 3 is closed only nominally: this commit removed `worker_resource_context`/`previous_resource_context` from the harness `res_id` lookup, and the real `AIReviewerCoordinator` metadata carries neither `resource_id` nor `resource_context`, so every production reviewer harness session persists `resource_id=None`; the one production timeout call site in ai_reviewer.py passes no `resource_id` at all, so the new `if not request_id or not resource_id ... return 0` guard makes the call a guaranteed no-op, and the session-matching line `s_info.get('resource_id') != resource_id` can never match. Both production call sites are therefore dead while the contract and result log claim correlated cleanup is wired. (3) The single production actuation path reserves the attempt with `effect_id = authorized_effect['target_resource_id']` and only rebinds it to `command_id` after `submit_control_command` returns; a crash in that window leaves a queued recovery command that `ControlCommandCoordinator` permanently rejects as 'unbound resource recovery command' (it requires `reserved['effect_id'] == command_id`), while `reconcile_recovery_attempts` cannot bind the command either (it looks up `cmd_store.get(eff_id)` with the resource id) and silently marks the attempt `abandoned` after TTL with no owner gate, and the watchdog refuses to retry because the `failed_plan_id` is already in `attempts` — a silent non-converging stall in exactly the CPF-03/CPF-07 path the contract claims converges without manual continuation. All three are bounded fixes plus regression tests; no design reopening and no owner input required. Non-blocking notes (must not consume a remediation round): `restart_recovery_cycle` is now permanently False so the `while True:` wrapper and `max_recovery_cycles` affect only message text; `project_config.get('ai_roles', {}).get('planner', {})` in watchdog.py raises AttributeError when `ai_roles` is present but null (line 1737 already uses the `or {}` form); `DefaultReviewerHarness.status()` rewrites runtime/harness-sessions.json on every 0.2s poll for the full review timeout.

qualification: REMEDIATE; not authoritative acceptance or soak
